title: Laparoscopic Surgical Management of Endometriosis on Fertility
brief_summary: The aim of the investigators study is to know the results of the endometriosis surgery and particularly to highlight a benefit of this surgery on fertility.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over 18 years
* Patients operated by laparoscopy for endometriosis in our department between 2006 and 2014.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under 18 years
study_population: This work concerns patients aged 18-38 years, operated by laparoscopy for endometriosis in our department between 2006 and 2014
